_note: Every source AfriEdge covers or plans to cover. Static facts (licensing, whether a loader exists) live here and are reviewed by hand; live facts (last success, last failure) come from the data_source_status table that each loader writes. 'probe' is the last run of pipelines.probe_sources. A source with parser_state NOT_BUILT can never show a last success. Licensing words (owner's directive of 2026-10-07): PUBLIC (terms read and reuse allowed), LICENSE_REQUIRED, LICENSE_REVIEW_REQUIRED (terms not yet read or unclear), RESTRICTED (terms prohibit the use without a licence). Evidence: docs/DATA_SOURCE_MATRIX.md, docs/COMPLIANCE_NOTES.md.

sources.name: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange
sources.datasets: Listed companies (discovered from the exchange's list); daily prices, volume, turnover, high and low for every share that passes the jump check; DSEI, TSI and the three sector indices (BI, IA, CS)
sources.licensing_note: DSE Data Vending Policy v1.2 (checked 2026-10-07): cl. 23.1 prohibits reproducing or redistributing market data from the DSE website without written licensing authorization; cl. 4.5(ii) makes anyone providing end-of-day data to end users a Distributor needing a data agreement and fees. Path: LICENSE_REQUIRED (EOD distributor agreement, data@dse.co.tz). Used internally by the owner's decision of 2026-09-19; public display controlled by DSE_PUBLIC_DISPLAY

sources.name: Issuer annual reports (NMB, CRDB investor relations)
sources.licensing_note: Published by the issuers for investors; figures are extracted with page citations. Republishing our stored PDF copies is a separate open question (LICENSE_REVIEW_REQUIRED)
